title: ORCA:Orthogonal Residual Consensus Alignment for Multi-View Clustering
abstract: arXiv:2611.16749v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep multi-view clustering often suffers from redundant information accumulation during fusion and indiscriminate alignment across representation levels. We propose Orthogonal Residual Consensus Alignment (ORCA) to address these challenges. Its semantic incremental recurrent fusion module extracts cross-view orthogonal residuals as non-redundant increments and adaptively weights recurrent states through divergence-guided gating. Its consensus-calibrated hierarchical contrastive alignment module uses the global consensus to weight contrastive alignment of view-level, pairwise, and recurrent representations. Together, these modules balance view-specific structure with cross-view consistency. Experiments on five benchmarks against fifteen competing methods demonstrate ORCA's effectiveness, including a 5.25 percent accuracy improvement over the strongest baseline on 100leaves. Ablation studies validate both modules. Code is available at ht

translated_title: ORCA：面向多视图聚类的正交残差共识对齐方法
translated_abstract: 深度多视图聚类在融合过程中常常面临冗余信息积累的问题，并且在表示层级之间进行不加区分的对齐。我们提出正交残差共识对齐（ORCA）方法来应对这些挑战。其语义增量循环融合模块提取跨视图正交残差作为非冗余增量，并通过散度引导的门控机制自适应地对循环状态进行加权。其共识校准的分层对比对齐模块利用全局共识对视图级、成对以及循环表示的对比对齐进行加权。两个模块协同工作，在视图特定结构与跨视图一致性之间取得平衡。在五个基准数据集上与十五种竞争方法的对比实验证明了ORCA的有效性，其中包括在100leaves数据集上相比最强基线准确率提升了5.25%。消融实验验证了两个模块的有效性。代码已开源于（链接被截断）。
tldr: ORCA通过提取跨视图正交残差的语义增量循环融合模块和基于全局共识校准的分层对比对齐模块，解决了多视图聚类中的冗余信息积累与表示层级无差别对齐问题，在五个基准数据集上取得显著性能提升。
en_tdlr: ORCA tackles redundant information accumulation and indiscriminate cross-level alignment in deep multi-view clustering by extracting cross-view orthogonal residuals for recurrent fusion and calibrating hierarchical contrastive alignment with global consensus, achieving superior results on five benchmarks.
